# telnyx_notification_setting (Data Source)

A notification setting, which sends a notification through a channel of a notification profile when a notification event condition is met. The API cannot change it, so every change replaces it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the notification setting.

### Read-Only

- `associated_record_type` (String) The type of record the setting applies to.
- `associated_record_type_value` (String) The record the setting applies to.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `notification_channel_id` (String) A UUID reference to the associated Notification Channel.
- `notification_event_condition_id` (String) A UUID reference to the associated Notification Event Condition.
- `notification_profile_id` (String) A UUID reference to the associated Notification Profile.
- `parameters` (Attributes List) The parameters of the event condition, such as a threshold. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `status` (String) Most preferences apply immediately; however, other may needs to propagate.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The parameter name.
- `value` (String) The parameter value.
